name: Protein
what_is: Protein is a nutrient made of amino acids. Foods can contain very different amounts and combinations of these amino acids.
why_botia: The nutrition table tells you how much protein is declared, but not its amino-acid composition or quality. BOTIA keeps that declared amount separate from the regulatory rules and evidence that give the number context.
can_1: Read the protein value declared on the nutrition label and preserve its unit and basis.
can_2: Connect the declared value with the applicable regulatory information and documented evidence.
cannot_1: Determine the amino-acid profile or protein quality from the declared protein value alone.
cannot_2: Determine an individual's protein requirement from the nutrition label.
cannot_3: Treat an undeclared protein value as zero.
